answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 30945 Country: United Kingdom Title: If you say wallhi i didnt do so and so but later you realised you did do u still have to keep 3 roza's? Question: If you say wallhi i didnt do so and so but later you realised you did do u still have to keep 3 roza's? Answer ID: 30945 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 611/371/D=1432) It is a major sin to swear false on a past matter and its kaffarah is tauba and istighfar. He should ask Allah's forgiveness. In this case, the kaffarah of fast or feeding shall not be applicable. فالغموس هوالحلف على امر ماض يتعمدالكذب فيه فهذه اليمين ياثم فيما صاحبها ولا كفارة فيها الا التوبة والاستغفار . (شرح البداية) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
